title: JCFB V4 PRE-BATCH-04 runtime case execution contract

cases.setup: Create an isolated competition and two teams; no match row exists before the action.
cases.action: Insert one canonical core.matches row as the simulated executor role.
cases.cleanup: Rollback the complete case transaction, including fixture and audit rows.

cases.setup: Create one canonical match using a deterministic data_date and official_match_no.
cases.action: Insert a second match with a different identity but the same data_date and official_match_no.
cases.cleanup: Rollback the case transaction and assert the original match remains the only row before rollback.

cases.setup: Create an isolated canonical match and a five-key official market availability map.
cases.action: Insert an official snapshot with one market explicitly UNAVAILABLE, a reason, and no payload for that market.
cases.cleanup: Rollback the complete case transaction.

cases.setup: Create an isolated canonical match and mark spf AVAILABLE while omitting its payload.
cases.action: Insert the malformed official odds snapshot.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint, verify no snapshot row, then rollback the case transaction.

cases.setup: Create an isolated canonical match and five available market states; rqspf payload has no official_handicap.
cases.action: Insert the malformed official odds snapshot.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint, verify no snapshot row, then rollback the case transaction.

cases.setup: Create a pre-match Production frozen-input, feature-bundle, and model/engine lineage with cutoff before kickoff.
cases.action: Insert a Production engine run whose run_at is after kickoff.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and rollback all isolated fixtures.

cases.setup: Create a FROZEN immutable model input with valid model and engine references.
cases.action: Attempt to update a non-exempt field on the frozen input.
cases.cleanup: Rollback the action savepoint, verify the frozen row is unchanged, then rollback the case transaction.

cases.setup: Create a valid immutable frozen prediction and its pre-match lineage.
cases.action: Attempt both a no-op UPDATE and a DELETE of the frozen prediction.
cases.cleanup: Rollback each action savepoint and verify the frozen prediction remains present.

cases.setup: Create a canonical match and one verified official result revision.
cases.action: Insert revision two with the predecessor, correction reason, correction actor, and new evidence/hash metadata.
cases.cleanup: Rollback the complete case transaction.

cases.setup: Create a frozen prediction for match A and an official result for match B.
cases.action: Insert a MODEL_EVALUATION review that combines the frozen prediction from A with the result from B.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and verify no review row exists.

cases.setup: Create same-match Production and Shadow predictions that reference the same frozen input identity but declare different frozen_input_hash values.
cases.action: Insert the Tier A sample pair.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and rollback all pair fixtures.

cases.setup: Create a Production pair fixture and an Experiment prediction/engine identity.
cases.action: Use the Experiment prediction as the forward Tier A shadow member.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and rollback all isolated fixtures.

cases.setup: Create a Production active registry plus Shadow prediction/frozen-prediction rows; no public projection exists.
cases.action: Attempt to publish a projection using Shadow lineage, then query public views for non-Production rows.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and rollback the complete case transaction.

cases.setup: Insert one approved active Production model pointer for one family/channel.
cases.action: Insert a second active Production model pointer for the same family/channel.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint, verify one active pointer, then rollback the case transaction.

cases.setup: Create an isolated match fixture as service_role; anon and authenticated have no internal-table write grant.
cases.action: Attempt the same internal core.matches insert as anon and authenticated.
cases.cleanup: Rollback each action savepoint and verify no public-role match row was inserted.

cases.setup: Create isolated competition/team fixtures; backend and service_role are local server-side controlled writers.
cases.action: Insert valid matches through backend and service_role and verify critical audit triggers run.
cases.cleanup: Rollback the complete case transaction.

cases.setup: No fixture row is needed; inspect only pg_proc and pg_catalog metadata.
cases.action: Check local SECURITY DEFINER functions for fixed search_path and restricted exposure; do not invoke Supabase Advisor.
cases.cleanup: No data mutation; transaction is rolled back for uniform case isolation.

cases.setup: Create an active Production projection with distinct real business timestamps and a later published/page timestamp.
cases.action: Read v_canonical_latest_update and v_public_predictions and compare the result to the maximum source business timestamp.
cases.cleanup: Rollback the projection and all fixtures.

cases.setup: Create an isolated competition/team fixture and a clean audit stream.
cases.action: Insert a canonical match and inspect its audit event envelope and hash fields.
cases.cleanup: Rollback the complete case transaction.

cases.setup: Capture the pg_catalog V3.3.3-name boundary before the case; no V3.3.3 table or payload is opened.
cases.action: Capture the same catalog boundary after the no-op runtime case and require no V3.3.3 object or row surface.
cases.cleanup: No V4 data mutation; rollback the case transaction.

cases.setup: Create an isolated canonical match with an AVAILABLE official spf market and no payload.
cases.action: Insert the malformed official odds snapshot.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and verify no snapshot row.

cases.setup: Create an isolated match and mark one official market UNAVAILABLE with an empty reason and no reason-map value.
cases.action: Insert the malformed official odds snapshot.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and verify no snapshot row.

cases.setup: Create an isolated match with all official markets AVAILABLE and rqspf payload without official_handicap.
cases.action: Insert the malformed official odds snapshot.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and verify no snapshot row.

cases.setup: Create valid pre-match Production runtime lineage.
cases.action: Insert a completed Production engine run after kickoff.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and rollback all fixtures.

cases.setup: Create a FROZEN immutable input with valid lineage refs.
cases.action: Attempt a mutation without the controlled FREEZE_GATE context.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and verify the original row is unchanged.

cases.setup: Create an immutable frozen prediction.
cases.action: Attempt update and delete operations, including a no-op update.
cases.cleanup: Rollback each action savepoint and verify the row remains.

cases.setup: Create a frozen prediction for match A and a verified result for match B.
cases.action: Insert a review that crosses the match identities.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and verify no review row.

cases.setup: Create same-match Production/Shadow predictions with different frozen input hashes.
cases.action: Insert a Tier A sample claiming the pair is eligible.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and rollback all pair fixtures.

cases.setup: Create a valid Production pair fixture plus an Experiment prediction identity.
cases.action: Insert a Tier A sample using the Experiment prediction as its Shadow member.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and rollback all fixtures.

cases.setup: Create Production registry plus Shadow prediction/frozen-prediction lineage.
cases.action: Insert a PUBLISHED public projection with Shadow lineage in Production columns.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and verify no public projection row.

cases.setup: Insert one active Production model pointer for a family/channel.
cases.action: Insert a second active Production model pointer for the same family/channel.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and verify the first pointer is unchanged.

cases.setup: The disposable role has no CREATE privilege in the trusted V4 schemas.
cases.action: Attempt to install an unsafe SECURITY DEFINER probe function from the runtime role.
cases.cleanup: Rollback the DDL savepoint and verify the probe function is absent.

cases.setup: Create an isolated core fixture as service_role; public roles have no internal-table write grant.
cases.action: Attempt internal-table writes as anon and authenticated.
cases.cleanup: Rollback each action savepoint and verify no public-role row was inserted.

cases.setup: Create an active Production projection fixture whose real source business timestamps all precede kickoff.
cases.action: Attempt to publish a projection that substitutes a post-kickoff page/deploy time for a source business timestamp.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and verify the unsafe projection is absent.

cases.setup: Create a canonical match and an official market map with an unreadable/unknown state missing the required availability field.
cases.action: Insert the unknown market state and require explicit rejection rather than FALSE/0/default coercion.
cases.cleanup: Rollback to the action savepoint and verify no snapshot row.
